name: snipzr
description: Create branded short links, UTM campaign links and QR codes, and read cookie-less click analytics in Snipzr (snipzr.com), the URL shortener, from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Snipzr (snipzr.com) is a URL shortener for marketers and developers. Connect it to manage your short links from ChatGPT in plain language.

What you can do:
• Create short links one at a time, or up to 100 in one call, on the default domain or on your own branded domain, with custom back-halves.
• Build UTM campaign links that follow your workspace's UTM conventions, then shorten them.
• Find, update and delete links. Updates and deletes are marked destructive, so ChatGPT asks you first.
• Read clicks and QR scans per day for any link, with bot traffic counted separately, and campaign reports rolled up by utm_campaign.
• Make scannable QR codes in PNG, JPEG or SVG with your colors, a caption and a center logo.
• Check how many new links your account has left this period, and which workspaces and domains this connection can use.

You stay in control: when you connect, you sign in to Snipzr and choose the workspace ChatGPT may act in and what it may do, for example read-only. You can disconnect at any time in Snipzr Settings.

Requirements: a Snipzr account.

Privacy: the plugin calls only Snipzr's own API and receives only what each request needs, such as the address you ask to shorten.
capabilities: Create short links on your own domain
Read click and QR scan analytics
Update and delete links, with confirmation
defaultPrompt: Shorten https://example.com/launch with Snipzr and give me a QR code for it
How did my Snipzr links perform this week?
Build Snipzr campaign links for my newsletter, LinkedIn and X posts

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the new short URL on snipzr.com and its destination https://www.wikipedia.org/.

positive.description: Build and shorten UTM campaign links
positive.prompt: Create Snipzr campaign links for https://example.com/launch for my newsletter and LinkedIn, campaign fall-launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Two short links, one per channel, whose destinations carry utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign=fall-launch.

positive.description: Read click statistics with bots counted separately
positive.prompt: How many clicks did all my Snipzr links get in the last 30 days, and how many were from bots?
positive.expected_behavior: Per-link human clicks for the last 30 days, with bots, AI assistants and suspected automation counted separately.

positive.description: Make a QR code with a caption
positive.prompt: Make a QR code for my most recent Snipzr link with the caption Scan to join.
positive.expected_behavior: A PNG QR code with the caption Scan to join that opens the most recent short link when scanned.

positive.prompt: How many new links can I still create in Snipzr this month?
positive.expected_behavior: The account's plan, how many new links remain this period and when the count resets.

negative.description: Unrelated request: weather has nothing to do with links, so no Snipzr tool is called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: The user names another link service, so Snipzr is not used.
Snipzr does not send email, so no Snipzr tool is called and the user is told it cannot send messages.
negative.prompt: Email my newsletter subscribers the launch link.
